searched.title: Bambu PLA Basic Technical Data Sheet V3.0
searched.note: Linked by this set's store page (Download › "Filament TDS"). All 5 pages read page by page: Specifications (p.1), Recommended Printing Settings (p.1-2), Physical and Mechanical Properties (p.2-3), Other Physical and Chemical Properties and Specimen Test (p.3), test figures and Disclaimer (p.4-5). It describes PLA Basic in general: its Specifications rows (Net Filament Weight 1 kg; Spool Material ABS; Spool Size 200 × 67 mm) are the 1 kg spool's.

searched.title: Bambu PLA Basic Safety Data Sheet SDS20250724A00
searched.note: Linked by this set's store page (Download › "Filament MSDS"). All 18 pages read (p.1 is an image-only cover page, viewed as an image: report number and dates). Section 3 (p.4) gives the composition; section 9 (p.9-10) says "No data available" for melting point, density and the other physical data; sections 14-15 (p.13-15) say "Not hazardous goods" and "Not listed"; no certification is named.

documents.title: Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: The set has no colour option group: its options are Options ("PLA Basic Color Trial Set", "PLA Basic Color Trial Set + 4 Reusable Spools") and Size ("250g*12"). The hex list is therefore keyed by the colour names exactly as the hex table writes them, with no source_value_id; the 12 colours agree with the PLA Basic hex table.

Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 31 ± 3 MPa, elongation 7.5 ± 1.3 %, bending modulus 2370 ± 150 MPa, bending strength 59 ± 6 MPa, impact 13.8 ± 0.9 kJ/m²) are not stored. Raw-material properties (density, thermal) and printed-specimen results (mechanical) sit in distinct keys.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 2580 ± 220 MPa), melt index (23.2 ± 3.5 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), saturated water absorption (0.43 %), retraction, chamber temperature, overhang, bridging, humidity, support material.

material.spool_type is not_published for this set: the TDS rows "Spool Material ABS" and "Spool Size 200 × 67 mm" describe the standard 1 kg spool, and this set's page says the AMS needs the filament moved to a Bambu Reusable Spool and the AMS lite needs an adapter, so those rows are not this set's spool. None of the documents names the set's spool.

No in-the-box list and no package.contents value: no official packing list exists for this set (the 12 colours are in the hex list). The option "PLA Basic Color Trial Set + 4 Reusable Spools" names an addition, written as the option-scoped "includes" relation, not as a packing list.

Not extracted: safety.certifications. The page links a RoHS certificate (cdn.shopify.com …/Bambu_PLA_Basic_RoHS.pdf) that is not in the offline cache, so the key is neither stated nor marked not_published.

Not stored: compat.statement. The FAQ sentence "Compatible with all printers, AMS, build plate, and nozzles." is qualified on the same page (AMS needs a reusable spool, AMS lite an adapter), so it is carried by the relations with their conditions instead of a bare statement.

The SDS names the model "A00-xx (xx stands for any suffix)" for Bambu PLA Basic in general; no identity key is written from it because the set's own SKU codes are not published (manifest sku_codes is empty).

Adjudication against the second extraction (68 field disagreements; every disputed fact re-read in the cached TDS, hex table, three wiki pages and the cached store page). Same fact, this file's form kept (31): the TDS and hex locator wording ("p.N, Section › Row"; every hex cell re-read: name, row, column, code) and the FAQ locator ("FAQ (Printing Tips) › 1.Accessory Compatibility": the page's FAQ block is titled "Printing Tips"). thermal.heat_deflection_temp stays the TDS 1.8 MPa row (54 °C), as in every other filament file; the second took the 0.45 MPa row (57 °C). Taken from the second after reading the documents: material.net_weight scoped to the Size value "250g*12" instead of the product (see its note), extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters (TDS p.1 Nozzle Size, as in the PLA Basic filament file) and the option-scoped "includes Reusable Spool" relation (option value "PLA Basic Color Trial Set + 4 Reusable Spools"). Kept from this file: the family targets (all_bambu_printers; ams_series with the reusable-spool and adapter conditions), the bambu-reusable-spool handle (compat-targets requirement_targets), the adapter as target_kind other with its MakerWorld link (a printable model, not a store part) and the TDS plate and nozzle relations. Not taken: material.diameter_tolerance (the builder already writes the store bullet "Diameter: 1.75mm +/- 0.03mm" as a verified product row, as in the other filament files), a separate AMS lite relation (the ams_series family relation and the requires-adapter relation carry it) and an "external spool" relation (not a product target; Cautions for Use › bullet 1 "Can be used directly with an external spool" is kept as the condition of the requires-spool relation).
